claims.claim: Identity and tradability remain validated for Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated (NASDAQ: VRTX; CIK 0000875320).

Fresh issuer evidence materially updates the prior February evidence: Q2 2026 revenue was $3.33B, up 12% year over year; full-year 2026 revenue guidance was raised to $13.1B-$13.2B; cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities were $13.6B at June 30, 2026.
The Crinetics acquisition remained pending as of the August 3 Q2 release, with closing anticipated in Q3 2026, so realized integration economics remain unproven.
A September 2026 independent market-data source places VRTX market capitalization near $133.36B, providing a current valuation reference distinct from issuer disclosure.
